authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
rules: R2007+ stores format flags as BL group 93 and data type as BL group 90.
A set first flag bit suppresses the type-specific payload; with that bit clear, type-specific fields follow.
Type 4 is TV; type 8 is BL byte count followed by that many bytes.
authority.scopeLimit: The specification does not assign semantic meaning to flag value 4. Preserve that integer as opaque metadata. A flags=4/type=8 root profile is admitted. ODA §20.4.99 and LibreDWG master both describe the type-4 payload as text; the unresolved disagreement is the later FIELD group-98 value_string_length field (ODA lists TV, LibreDWG's object schema uses BL), followed by a child-count framing failure in the local physical sample. Do not promote type 4 from the peer layout alone.

currentFailure.physicalTraceBeforeChange: The local AC1021 read retained five FIELD roots at handles 0x2392-0x2396 as incomplete raw shells.

diagnosticAttempt.temporaryResult: A temporary diagnostic admitted flags=4/type=4 only to trace the existing ODA TV text payload path. All four roots reached the later child-value-count field but decoded an out-of-range count. The temporary path was removed. This does not show a type-4 payload layout difference: LibreDWG master also uses FIELD_T for the kString payload.

authority.fieldLayout: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.76 lists the value string as TV group 301 and value-string length as TV group 98; §20.4.99 defines kString/type 4 as TV.
authority.peerImplementation: LibreDWG master src/dwg_spec_shared.h TABLE_value_fields uses FIELD_T for kString/type 4. Its src/dwg.spec FIELD object uses FIELD_T(value_string, 301) followed by FIELD_BL(value_string_length, 98), with the source comment 'ODA bug TV'.
authority.qualification: The ODA specification remains authoritative for byte layout. LibreDWG is an implementation differential only; the shared type-4 payload does not settle group-98 encoding or the local child-count failure.

physicalDiagnostic.profile: The local AC1021 roots have flags=4/type=4. The temporary local reader reached the text value, then read the group-98 candidate as BL and reached the following child-count read.
physicalDiagnostic.peerComparison: All four BL length candidates equal the corresponding LibreDWG 0.14 JSON values, including the anomalous 272695808 value. This is parser agreement, not semantic or normative proof.
physicalDiagnostic.interpretation: The group-98 discrepancy is a candidate cause, not a proven explanation for the child-count failure. Do not change the decoder or admit type 4 until the physical bit spans for group 98 and group 93 are independently established against a conforming producer/parser.

odaTvProbe.method: A temporary, unretained reader change decoded group 98 as TV from the bounded AC1021 detached string stream after valueString, following ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.76. It logged the text-stream bit span and attempted a strict nonnegative decimal conversion.
odaTvProbe.result: All four candidates decode an empty TV, not a decimal length, and remain incomplete. The probe was reverted. Under that layout the next child-count BL would be the first body BL candidate previously read as valueStringLength (112, 16, 272695808, and 4 respectively); this does not resolve the following child-count framing.
odaTvProbe.decision: No admission. The normative TV interpretation and physical body-stream BL candidates still fail to produce a coherent group-98/group-93 span. Obtain a producer-backed or independently traced conforming sample before changing the decoder.
